network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto pubblica 7,29 m al Tammaro di Pago Veiano e i precursori pluviometrici del Tammarecchia, ma non una misura idrometrica sul Tammarecchia. Il livello del fiume ricevente non viene assegnato al ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The report publishes 7.29 m for the Tammaro at Pago Veiano and rainfall precursors for the Tammarecchia, but no Tammarecchia gauge measurement. The receiving-river stage is not assigned to the bridge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
